name: vedeo
description: Make short narrated videos from a prompt or a script: check the cost, create, track and download.

interface.longDescription:
VEDEO turns an idea or a finished script into a short video with narration, captions, footage and music, ready to post.

Connect your VEDEO account and ask for a video in conversation. ChatGPT tells you what it will cost in your VEDEO credits and what you have, starts the video once you agree, lets you know when it is finished, and gives you a link to download it. You can also list your recent videos and cancel one that has not started rendering.

You choose what ChatGPT may do when you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time in VEDEO's Settings. It uses the credits already in your VEDEO account. It cannot buy credits, change your plan, or see your password or payment details.
defaultPrompt: What would a 45-second vertical video about three habits for meeting deadlines cost me?
Turn this script into a 30-second square video, narrated exactly as written.
Show my recent videos and give me a download link for the newest finished one.

positive.description: See what the account can make and what it has to spend.
positive.prompt: What kinds of video can I make with VEDEO, and how many credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available kinds of video with their durations, and reports the account's plan and the credits it can spend. Nothing is created and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Price a video without making it.
positive.prompt: How much would a 45-second vertical educational video about three habits for meeting deadlines cost?
positive.expected_behavior: States the cost in credits and the balance that would remain, and says the plan allows it. It does not start a video, and asks whether to go ahead.

positive.description: Make a video after confirming the cost, then follow it until it is finished.
positive.prompt: Yes, make that video. You can spend up to 20 credits on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks ChatGPT's own confirmation before the write, then starts the video with a maximum of 20 credits, reports the credits reserved and the balance left, and says rendering takes a few minutes. Asked for an update, it reports the status and progress, and finally that the video is completed.

positive.description: Find a finished video and get its file.
positive.prompt: Show me my recent videos and give me a download link for the newest one that is finished.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent videos newest first with their status, then gives a download link for the newest completed one and says the link works for about an hour.

positive.description: Narrate a script the person wrote, word for word, in a chosen format and voice.
positive.prompt: Here is my script: "Deadlines are met on Monday, not Friday. Start with the smallest piece, and tell someone when you will finish." Make a 30-second square video that narrates exactly this, in a female voice. Up to 15 credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a female voice from the list, states the cost, and after confirmation starts a 1:1, 30-second video that carries the script unchanged. It does not rewrite the script.

negative.description: Buying credits or changing the plan is not something this app can do. It should say so and explain that credits and plans are managed in VEDEO itself, without giving prices or a purchase link.
negative.prompt: I'm out of credits. Buy me 300 more and upgrade me to the Studio plan.

negative.description: The app only reaches the connected account. It should decline and say it can only see the videos of the account that was connected.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos in the VEDEO account that belongs to jane@example.com.

negative.description: There is no tool that deletes videos, and a video that is already rendering cannot be cancelled. It should say it cannot delete videos and that this is done in VEDEO, and should not claim to have removed anything.
negative.prompt: Delete every video in my VEDEO library.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell anything or take payment. Videos use credits already in the person's VEDEO account. It cannot buy credits or change a plan, and gives no prices or purchase links.

publication.release_notes: First release: check a video's cost, create it, follow its progress, download it, list recent videos, and cancel one that has not started rendering.
